title: High usage MCP retrieval
summary: Improve the local read-only code-context MCP with measured retrieval quality, atomic index freshness, revision-aware caches, privacy-safe aggregate metrics, and a budgeted multi-file read tool.
reason: High-volume chatbot sessions need fresher catalog results, fewer read round trips, measurable retrieval quality, and cache behavior that remains correct as the generated index changes.
behavior_before: The MCP loads its catalog once per process, caches only exact context prompts, exposes four single-query/read tools, and has no aggregate quality benchmark or operational counters.
behavior_after: The MCP atomically reloads valid catalog revisions, uses normalized revision-aware caches, exposes a token-bounded code_bundle tool, emits content-free aggregate metrics, and has a versioned retrieval-quality benchmark.
